# Pinned ICU data fixture

`icudtl-flutter-icu78.dat` is copied byte-for-byte from:

`v8-152.2.0/third_party/icu/flutter_desktop/icudtl.dat`

The source was the crates.io `v8` package version `152.2.0`, whose
`.cargo_vcs_info.json` records rusty_v8 commit
`2768994f664e8a6e3aba27503606c58339136e2a`. The packaged ICU
`version.json` records major version 78.
